create_device_context: create a DeviceContext to set the default device for tensor creation operations
build_device_decorator: build a device_decorator to apply a default device to a specific function
test_set_device: test the set_device decorator to wrap a function with a default device
review_device_constructors: review _device_constructors to list tensor creation functions that respect device context
summarize_current_device: summarize the CURRENT_DEVICE global variable used to track the active device context
